query_text: Explain the CAP theorem in distributed systems with trade-offs.
expected_answer: The CAP theorem states that a distributed data store can guarantee at most two out of three properties: Consistency (every read gets the latest write), Availability (every request receives a non-error response), and Partition Tolerance (system continues functioning despite network packet drops).
